summary.decision: Ludwig missing-thickness records remain blocked pending official/catalog numeric shell-thickness source review.

decisions.reason: Packet identifies candidates, but no reviewed official/catalog numeric shell-thickness evidence has been attached yet. Keep blocked until source-backed shell thickness is confirmed.
requiredBeforePromotion: Official Ludwig page, catalog, archived catalog, manual, or distributor spec confirming numeric shell thickness.
Evidence must describe actual shell thickness, not only shell construction, shell material, ply count, line name, hoop type, or era.
Line-level promotion requires evidence that clearly applies across the candidate records/era.
